name: Summed up, the briefing keeps the open thread, and the next turn carries on from it

history.asked: Why does the simulation blow up when two bodies pass close?
history.said: The force goes as 1/r², so it grows without bound as r goes to 0. Your note on [softening](/physics/softening.md) is the fix.

history.asked: I still don't see why softening removes the singularity. Leave it for now, I'll come back to it.
history.said: Of course. We can come back to softening whenever you like.

history.asked: What units do my notes use?
history.said: G = 1, with masses and lengths in the units of [Units](/physics/units.md).

turn.asked: Let's pick up the thing I said I'd come back to.
